node.title: Re: I am confused by a "Learning Perl" sample showing "unshift"
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
I expected "unshift @lArray, @lNums" to expand to "unshift @lArray, 1 2 3" and then be processed as though

The first part is correct (the contents of the @lNums array becomes part of the argument list to [doc://unshift]), and as for the second part, note it's very simple to express what you thought would happen using [doc://perlsyn#Statement-Modifiers]: unshift @lArray, $_ for @lNums;
